evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'this could take ten to fifteen minutes of your time' and 'is this a good time to talk about the move?' but does not explicitly promise 'a quote you can depend on' or wait meaningfully for affirmation before pivoting to confirmation of details.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'But aside from the pricing, ma'am, do you have any other concerns about the moving process?' — this comes after the rep has already confirmed the date and location, so it's asked after initial probing has started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises concern about PC packing. Rep responds with explanation of wrapping but does not ask 'tell me more about that' or dig deeper into the concern; instead pivots to whether customer wants packing services. No genuine two-layer follow-up.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides $206/hour rate for two movers, $576 travel fee, $150 for packing materials, 2.5-hour minimum, and gives range: '$2,374 to $2,580' — anchored and specific to this move (third-floor stair access, 8–9 hours estimated).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses hourly rate, travel fee, materials fee, mentions 'no heat fees of any type,' 'minimum of two and a half hour,' and 'fifteen minute increments' — all the standard framing is present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. After stating the estimate, rep immediately moves into 'we can also secure your truck now' without pause for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'Do you have any more questions before I let you go?' — this is a throwaway version, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' format.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. Rep does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asks 'So with that, would you like to be on the schedule for Saturday?' — clear, direct ask without a soft out.

top_strength: Rep gathered all essential logistics details (property type, floor, distances, room count, appliances, special items) methodically and confirmed details at the end, building a complete and accurate estimate.
coaching_note: Two Promises section (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) was completely skipped — this is a 10-point gap and a core part of the pitch; add this section every call before moving to final concerns.
